en.headline: Hong Kong Maritime Week opens for 10th anniversary with over 60 events
en.dek: The week-long programme starting today brings more than 18,000 participants and will see the government announce new partner ports.
body: Hong Kong Maritime Week 2026 begins today and runs through 21 November, marking the event’s 10th anniversary. Organisers expect more than 18,000 people to take part in online and offline activities.

The government-coordinated programme is organised by the Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board, with the Hong Kong Shipowners Association and Hong Kong Maritime Museum as co-organisers. More than 80 local, mainland and overseas organisations are staging over 60 events, including flagship forums, seminars and exhibitions.

The Transport and Logistics Bureau said it would announce a new batch of partner ports and sign several maritime-related memoranda of understanding during the week. Key sessions include the opening ceremony and World Maritime Merchants Forum on 16 November, and the Asian Logistics, Maritime and Aviation Conference on 16–17 November.

Officials noted that the national 15th Five-Year Plan supports Hong Kong’s dual-hub status as an international maritime centre and aviation hub. The week also includes a 10-episode television series produced with TVB to highlight careers in the sector.

zh.headline: 香港海運周十周年今日揭幕 逾60場活動吸引1.8萬人參與
zh.dek: 為期七天的活動由今日起舉行，政府將公布新一批夥伴港口並簽署多項合作備忘錄。
body: 香港海運周2026今日起一連七日舉行，至11月21日止，適逢十周年。主辦單位預計線上線下共有超過1.8萬人參與。
活動由特區政府統籌，香港海運港口發展局主辦，香港船東會及香港海事博物館合辦。逾80家本地、內地及海外機構合共舉辦超過60場活動，涵蓋旗艦論壇、研討會及展覽。
運輸及物流局表示，期間將公布新一批夥伴港口，並簽署多項與航運相關的合作備忘錄。重點包括16日的開幕典禮暨世界航商大會，以及16至17日的亞洲物流航運及空運會議。
官員指出，國家《十五五規劃綱要》支持香港鞏固國際航運中心及國際航空樞紐的雙樞紐地位。運輸及物流局亦夥拍無綫電視製作十集宣傳短劇，介紹航運業實況。
